texts.preamble: Sunil Yadav @ Bhole vs State Of U.P. on 26 August, 2019
texts.facts: The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Sunil Yadav @ Bhole with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 279 of 2019, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 272 IPC, section 60(1), 63, 72 of Excise Act and section 63 of Copy Right Act Police Station Civil Lines, District- Etawah, during pendency of trial.
texts.arguments: It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case with some ulterior motive. Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has been enacted by the legislature and hence the implication of the applicant under section 272 I.P.C. is unjustified. Offence under section 60 of Excise Act is bailable and trible by Magistrate. False recovery has been alleged. The applicant is languishing in jail since 22.7.2019, who is not a Sunil Yadav @ Bhole vs State Of U.P. on 26 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36084475/ 1 previous convict. In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail. Per contra learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that the innocence of the applicant cannot be adjudged at pre trial stage, therefore, he does not deserves any indulgence. In case the applicant is released on bail he will again indulge in similar activities and will misuse the liberty of bail. Having considered the submissions of the parties noted above, larger mandate of the Article 21 of the Constitution of India and the dictum of Apex Court in the case of Dataram Singh Vs. State of U.P. and another reported in (2018)3 SCC 22 and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, let the applicant Sunil Yadav @ Bhole involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions that :- 1.
